+def choose_audio_chunk_separator(
+    language: str | None, no_space_languages: Set[str]
+) -> str:
+    """Return the separator used between audio-chunk transcripts."""
+    return "" if language and language.lower() in no_space_languages else " "
+
+
+def merge_audio_chunk_text(left: str, right: str, separator: str) -> str:
+    """Join adjacent audio chunks without duplicating existing whitespace."""
+    if not left:
+        return right
+    if not right:
+        return left
+    if not separator or left[-1].isspace() or right[0].isspace():
+        return left + right
+    return left + separator + right
+
